judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core Ajv validation in `ToolRegistry` and passes basic validation scenarios, but the implementation was left mid-flight as shown by `.lore/dod.md` and the `In Progress` spec status. In `registry.ts`, function-valued tool definitions are erroneously compiled at `register` time as well as recompiled on every `execute` call without caching by schema object (`WeakMap`), violating the requirement to cache resolved dynamic schemas. Furthermore, most required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra property passthrough, dynamic schema changes, unknown tool throw, static compilation once) and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, with only 1 unit test in `registry.test.ts` and 4 tests placed in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file. Finally, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were made, and `CHANGELOG.md` only mentions `register` rather than `execute` validation and its migration note.
